versions.notes: Liquid 2: sun/moon quick-theme button in home, post detail, notifications, profile and settings top bars. Animated reveal originates at the tapped button; theme persists through the existing settings store. Same package/signature as Liquid 1, higher version code 149. Android device validation still outstanding.

Independent Liquid fork: real-content liquid theme reveal, opt-in local synthesized water audio, persisted volume and animation settings. Separate package and signature; no automatic login-data migration. Based on upstream 1.3.10 (148). Android physical-device validation is still outstanding.
